about: Vermilion River County is a municipal district in east-central Alberta surrounding the separate Town of Vermilion—not the town itself. Hamlets such as Kitscoty, Marwayne, Paradise Valley, Dewberry, and Islay sit among prairie farms toward the Saskatchewan boundary. About 8,000 people live in Vermilion River County.
